Better PvP Visual makes your gameplay cleaner by reducing visual chaos. Perfect for all PvP styles (CPVP, Mace & Vanilla)!

✨ Key Features:

Clearer Vision: Removes pumpkin blur, crystal/campfire/fire smoke, and intrusive totem pop particles.

Smaller Items: Reduced on-screen sizes for Totems, Shields, and Golden Apples.

Sleek UI: Black GUIs for a clean dark mode look, plus a simpler, cleaner custom font.

3D Models: Custom 3D visuals for the Mace and End Crystals.

New Animations: Upgraded effects for Firework Rockets, Blaze Powder, and Ender Pearls.

Optimized Textures: Tweaked redstone, tools, and crystals to maximize your screen space.

Snow Alerts: Adds a warning exclamation mark to powder snow to prevent accidental falls.

📜 Credits & Info:
Compiled by @aimluca. Huge thanks to the original creators whose features were combined here: Vanilla Plus V2 (3D), Totem Tweaks, Powder Snow Alerts, Mace but 3D, & Vanilla-Plus.

💬 Support:
Have any problems? Feel free to contact me on DS!
